ModMetaData.name: Martial Armory
ModMetaData.author: throwingfish
ModMetaData.description:
Adds classic D&D and historical non-magical melee weapons and physical shields with mechanical 1-handed vs 2-handed weapon restrictions and active shield blocking.
⚔️ Weapons Included: • Halberd (2H): Heavy polearm with high cutting power and armor-piercing reach. • Morningstar (1H): Spiked impact weapon dealing hybrid blunt force and puncture wounds. • War Pick (1H): Armor-penetrating pick engineered to pierce heavy plate and mechanoid armor. • Scimitar (1H): Fast curved blade with rapid attacks and severe bleed application. • Quarterstaff (2H): Sturdy blunt staff for non-lethal subdue and early-game defense.
🛡️ Shields (One-Handed Only): • Buckler: Small, nimble shield focused on high melee parry with zero move speed penalty. • Round Shield: Balanced, versatile circular shield protecting against melee and archery. • Kite Shield: Knightly teardrop shield covering legs and torso with strong frontal coverage. • Tower Shield: Massive barrier with supreme missile/melee deflection at the cost of movement speed.
⚙️ Mechanics: • One-Handed Only: Shields can only be wielded alongside one-handed weapons. Two-handed weapons (Halberd, Quarterstaff, Longsword, Spear, Warhammer, Greatbow) cannot be used with shields. • Active Blocking: Shields give pawns a dynamic chance to block incoming melee attacks and deflect projectiles based on shield stats and pawn manipulation/melee skill.
No DLC required.
